content_fields.title: Test authentication (Bash/Shell)
content_fields.description: Exercise the script's authentication guard so an unauthorized invocation is proven to fail.
content_fields.finding: There is no authentication step in the operational scripts to exercise.
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/tests/security/test_ops_scripts.sh
set -euo pipefail

unset SDE_DEPLOY_ROLE
if ./start_app.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "FAIL: start_app.sh ran without an operator identity" >&2
    exit 1
fi
echo "PASS: start_app.sh refused an unauthenticated invocation"
criteria: A test invokes the script without credentials and asserts a non-zero exit.
The test runs in CI alongside the Python suite.
